entry.title: Council releases 2 Digital Omnibus documents
entry.summary: 2 Council positions: Mandate for negotiations with the European Parliament; Mandate for negotiations with the European Parliament. Listed as not public since 4 Oct 2026; now public in the register. ST 13886/26 REV 1: ST 13886/26 REV 1 of 5 October 2026 is a revised note of the General Secretariat of the Council to the Permanent Representatives Committee with the Presidency's proposed mandate for negotiations with the European Parliament on the Digital Omnibus; it was put to Coreper for agreement and is neither the Council's position nor law. ST 13886/26: ST 13886/26 of 2 October 2026 is a note of the General Secretariat of the Council to the Permanent Representatives Committee with the Presidency's proposed mandate for negotiations with the European Parliament on the Digital Omnibus; it was put to Coreper for agreement and is neither the Council's position nor law.
